name: Tomas Tobé - Après le § 6 - Am 15
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 6a. Stresses that the proposed European Centre for Democratic Resilience should operate on the basis of a clearly defined mandate, transparent governance, appropriate democratic oversight and robust safeguards on fundamental rights; stresses that the Centre should primarily facilitate coordination, knowledge-sharing and independent analysis and should not acquire operational or monitoring functions that could affect the exercise of fundamental rights;
